intro.text: An ancient inhabited world and the site of the Shattering of Adonalsium.

description.text: Many of its trees are bone-white.

items.text: Yolen's old gods predated its dragons, and dragons predated humanity.
Humans developed separate city-states, while dragons maintained a more technologically advanced civilization.
In one city-state, a ruler tested whether a boy of low birth could match the accomplishments of the upper classes. The experiment became entangled with a coup against the city's barons.
